_fixture.prices: Only the NH Senate objects carry real captured prices. All other prices are ILLUSTRATIVE (WebSearch snippets of Kalshi/Polymarket news, late Sep-early Oct 2026). Never treat them as live.
_fixture.what: Kalshi Trade API v2 event reads. With with_nested_markets=true the markets sit in event.markets and the top-level 'markets' is [] (REAL, see SENATENH-26). /events list -> {events:[...], cursor} (cursor '' or absent = last page).
base_urls: https://api.elections.kalshi.com/trade-api/v2 (used by every participant repo; listed as 'Production shared API server, also supported')
unsure_fields: Only SENATENH-26 is a real capture. CONTROLS-2026/CONTROLH-2026 event+market titles, rules text and close/expiration times are ILLUSTRATIVE (the rule 'President pro tempore party on Feb 1 2027' comes from a sportsline/oddsshopper search snippet quoting Kalshi rules)
Kalshi market titles keep the REAL typo pattern 'Will Democratics win ...' (seen in SENATENH-26-D) for state races; do not parse party from title
Independent market ticker 'SENATENE-26-I' and its subtitle are GUESSES (participants fetch the event and match yes_sub_title by candidate name)
House title pattern 'AZ-01 House winner?' and governor 'Georgia governor winner?' come from christiano7777777/sig-arb-bot tools/build_kalshi_map.py title rules
settled primary KXSENATETXR-26 is illustrative (shape for filtering); status value 'finalized' assumed from the newer Kalshi status set
collateral_return_type, price_ranges, custom_strike, early_close_condition copied from the real NH capture

integer-cent fields (yes_bid, yes_ask, last_price, volume, open_interest, liquidity...) are ABSENT in the real capture: removed 2026-03-12 per Kalshi fixed-point migration doc snippet; the pip SDK kalshi_python_sync 3.2.0 still declares them (stale)
